text:
alex: quick sync 1 planning a tiny header-driven hint protocol so REST clients can opt into explicit route ids + quota keys without codegen. keeps proto-first mapping intact.
maria: okay but big security question - how do we prevent spoofing?
alex: two modes: (1) token introspection: auth returns allowed routes/quotas; (2) short HMAC-signed hint produced by Console/SDK. headers: X-RW-Route, X-RW-Quota-Key, X-RW-Canary (opt), X-RW-Trace (opt), X-RW-Debug-Token (opt). example:
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer <token>
X-RW-Route: model.generate
X-RW-Quota-Key: org:acme
X-RW-Sig: v1.hmac:abc123
{...}
jordan: we must keep a control-plane route registry mapping proto_service.method <-> route id. edge should prefer header route id, fallback to path+method lookup. add a lint to block orphaned route ids.
sam: quota resolution priority: header quota-key (signed) > tenant from token > route default. need support for aggregation labels (org/team) and clear rules for billing. tests for header claiming different org than token.
lucy: telemetry: emit counters rw.router.hint.accepted, rw.router.hint.rejected, rw.router.hint.sig_fail, and gauge rw.router.hint_fallback_rate. trace: propagate X-RW-Trace or attach new. debug: Console mints short-lived X-RW-Debug-Token signed by customer key.
maria: make the signed header UX easy in Console + SDK to avoid friction. rate-limit debug token minting.
alex: perf worry: per-request HMAC verify. mitigate with per-tenant key cache + short TTL and fast-path bloom check. measure in staging.
jordan: compatibility for legacy clients: JSON envelope {_route: "model.generate", payload: {...}} allowed but low trust - cannot escalate quotas/canaries. telemetry-mark envelope requests.
sam: Console route page: calls/min, p50/p95, quota consumption (daily/monthly), bound tenant, last canary. quick CTA to mint debug token.
deploy-bot: router-proxy v2 canary started in staging (canary-12) with route-hints ON. initial logs: rw.router.hint.accepted=32.
lucy: i'll add dashboards and an alert on hint.sig_fail spike.
alex: action items: alex RFC (header spec + security + fallback rules) by EOW. sam: quota-resolution pseudocode + tests. lucy: telemetry + dashboard. jordan: control-plane lint. maria: console token UX. perf sweep tomorrow in staging. :thumbsup:
